baseline_source.text: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַ/גּ֔וֹי לא הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַ/שִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כְּ/שִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּ/קָּצִ֔יר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּ/חַלְּקָ֥/ם שָׁלָֽל׃

baseline_english: You have multiplied the nation[a]; you have not increased the joy. They rejoice before you as with the joy at harvest[b], as men exult when they divide spoil.
declared_form: Pinned Masoretic base; compare written לא with recorded qere לו only. No silent adoption of conjectural first-colon or Greek literary form.
intent: Test reversal from negative joy to positive joy, separately adjudicating source selection and resulting English. Acquisition is exploratory; this contract precedes recorded candidate assessment, not all research.
